config.tabby_rpc.showWorldName.tooltip: Shows the name of the singleplayer world you are playing in.
config.tabby_rpc.showServerAddresses.too: Shows the address and the icon of the server you are playing on. Servers set to hidden when adding or editing them stay hidden.
config.tabby_rpc.allowJoinRequests.toolt: Lets others ask to join your world through Discord while it is shared with e4mc. The number of players is shown either way.
config.tabby_rpc.showDownloadButton.tool: Shows a button that leads others to Tabby RPC, or the buttons of your modpack. Discord hides them while others can ask to join your world.
tabby_rpc.joinRequest.unknown: There is no such request to join.
